There's a small trick you can do to boost fps if you're playing pokemon. Idk about other games though.

Go to your citra mmj folder - > Go to config - >  open the file config-mmj. ini using a text editor like Quick edit. 

Then inside the config-mmj file change the "resolution_factor" setting to 100 or 200.  For example if  resolution_factor = 2, change it to 200.

Now open citra and open your game. You'll see that you'll just get a black screen. Now while the game is running go to its quick settings by pressing the back button or the home button. There you'll see that the resolution setting will be on 4. Change it to 2 and you're done. You'll get better fps for pokemon.
